name: Recycling Adventure VR
summary:
Users will experience the process of becoming household waste or household sewage and recycling through resource circulation facilities at home from a first-person perspective. During your resource recycling journey, you will experience various mini-games.
Household waste: Experience the process of being discarded at home, incinerated in an incinerator, and reborn as a new resource
